description: Erection of a part single storey, part two storey extension to the front and side, erection of a single storey extension to the rear
decision_conditions: The proposed extensions, by reason of their combined siting, scale, bulk, design and proportions, would result in a visually dominant and incongruous form of development. The proposed two-storey side extension would fail to appear as a subordinate addition to the host dwelling and would instead appear as a separate building positioned alongside the original house, resulting in a development which lacks architectural cohesion and fails to harmonise with the established form, proportions and design of the original dwelling. The cumulative scale and massing of the proposed additions would further contribute to an overly bulky and cramped appearance which would be harmful to the visual amenities of the street scene and the character and appearance of the area. Therefore, the proposal would be contrary to Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One Strategic Policies (2012), Policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12 and DMHD 1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.
